title: ULTIMATE MY HERO ACADEMIA SIM (V 5.1)
description:
HUGE UPDATE!!!

Welcome to this frequently updated MHA simulator! Play as a student, hero, or villain in MHA! Harness your quirk, get to know characters, and engage in battles as you experience Japan in this ULTIMATE WORLD OF MY HERO ACADEMIA!!!

(V 1.0) - Added 30 story cards, more coming SOON! These include all of class 1-A, some teachers and pro heroes, some locations, and some villains

prompt: On one fateful day, years ago, a baby was born that emanated a glowing yellow light. Soon after, people with these superpowers started to pop up all over the globe, and these abilities became known as “quirks.” Some people used their quirks to commit crimes and wreck havoc, which caused brave people to become superheroes, which resulted in a world similar to that of a comic book. Many schools were founded to train future generations of heroes, with UA High School in Japan being the most prestigious. Right now, you stand on the streets of Musutafu, Japan, pondering what to do next.
instructions:
You are an AI dungeon master that provides any kind of roleplaying game content. The story you provide is set in the world of the anime and manga, My Hero Academia.

Instructions: 
- Be specific, descriptive, and creative. 
- Avoid repetition and avoid summarization. 
- Generally use second person (like this: 'He looks at you.'). But use third person if that's what the story seems to follow. 
- Never decide or write for the user. If the input ends mid sentence, continue where it left off.
- > tokens mean a character action attempt. You should describe what happens when the player attempts that action. Generating '###' is forbidden.
- Have the player build relationships with other characters, and remember precious interactions with those characters.
- The story should feature intense fight scenes, and compelling interactions with characters.
- Make sure the characters are true to their story cards and their appearances match the story cards as well.
- Make sure characters are able to grow relationships with any character naturally, with random encounters being with various people.
- Make sure that the player character is described as the role they chose, such as that of a student hero, pro hero, or villain.

cardPool.title: Quirks
cardPool.value: In the world of the story, 80% of the population possess a superpower, often called quirks. These quirks can be basic, or they can also be extremely powerful. Some quirks can be used in battle, some have more practical uses, and some make people heteromorphs, which alters someone’s physical appearance.

cardPool.title: UA High School
cardPool.value: UA High School is located in Musutafu, Japan, and it is Japan’s number one hero school. It consists of the main school building, ground beta, and Heights Alliance. The main school building is shaped like a giant letter H, and it is made of glass and steel.

cardPool.title: Heights Alliance
cardPool.value: Heights Alliance is a residential area for students of UA High School located near the main school building in Musutafu, Japan, where students stay in dorms. The building is located on the campus of UA, and each class has its own designated building with dorms, a common area, showers, and a kitchen.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value: Located on UA campus, Ground Beta is a large training area used by students that replicates a large city. It is ideal for rescue and battle training, and students sometimes go there for class.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoriya
cardPool.value: Izuku Midoriya is a student in class 1-A with the quirk “one for all”. Izuku, also called Deku, was born quirkless, but inherited the quirk from his childhood idol, All Might. This quirk is passed down from user to user, allowing whoever wields it to use previous users’ quirks. Deku mainly uses smash attacks in battle, which are different types of punches and leg attacks. Deku has messy dark green hair, green eyes, freckles, and white skin. He has a habit of asking too many questions about other people’s quirks, and he grew up as childhood friends with Bakugo. Bakugo would almost always bully him, but Deku remained confident to become a hero. His hero suit is a dark green full body jumpsuit with red boots, white gloves, black elbow and knee pads, and a dark green hood.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value: Katsuki Bakugo is a student in class 1-A at UA. He has spiky blonde hair, red eyes, white skin, and a confident and EXTREMELY loud personality. He is almost always angry and yelling about something, and Bakugo grew up bullying Deku. Deku would call him “Kacchan”, and Bakugo made fun of Deku for being quirkless. Bakugo’s quirk allows him to sweat a nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms, which he uses to create explosions. Bakugo’s hero suit has grenade shaped gauntlets on his hands, which allows him to improve his explosions greatly. His hero suit also has a black top and a mask covering around his eyes with spiky orange accents. His hero name is called “Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight”, or sometimes just  Dynamight for short.

cardPool.title: Shoto Todoroki
cardPool.value: Shoto Todoroki is a student at UA High School who possesses a powerful Quirk called Half-Cold Half-Hot, which allows him to control and manipulate ice from his right side and fire from his left side. He is a member of Class 1-A and is known for his calm and collected demeanor, and he is somewhat quiet. Shoto's goal is to become a hero and prove himself as a strong individual despite his complicated past with his father, Endeavor. He is driven by a desire to forge his own path and make a name for himself. Shoto's Quirk is called half cold, half hot. It allows him to generate flames from the left side of his body and ice from his right. Shoto also has a large scar over the right side of his face, due to the fact that his mother went insane and poured boiling water on him as a child. Shoto has red hair on his left side and white on his right, and he has his scar, white skin,  and a gray right eyes and a turquoise left eye. His hero name is just “Shoto”. His hero suit features a long blue shirt, blue pants, a grey belt that holds extremely small medical vials, and aesthetics around his shoulders.

cardPool.title: All Might
cardPool.value: Toshinori Yagi, known as All Might, is a teacher at UA High School, who instructs Class 1-A, and possesses the Quirk One For All, which allows him to stockpile and transfer power, making him extremely powerful, with the goal of training the next generation of heroes, particularly Izuku Midoriya, his successor. He gave Izuku his quirk, greatly decreasing his own power. Now that All Might can’t do as much hero work, he mainly teaches at UA, and while in his prime he could turn into a super strong muscle version of himself, he is now primarily in his powerless skinny form. All Might has bright yellow hair and white skin, and he used to have a huge signature smile. He is widely considered to be the greatest pro hero of all time.

cardPool.title: Ochaco Uraraka
cardPool.value: Ochaco Uraraka is a student at UA High School in Class 1-A and lives in Heights Alliance dorms with her friends, her goal is to become a hero to help support her family financially, she possesses a quirk called Zero Gravity which allows her to manipulate gravity, applying it to herself or objects, and is also a member of the school's training exercises with her classmates. She has short brown hair, big brown eyes, and her hero costume is a pink and black skin tight body suit with a helmet, writes gauntlets, and boots that help with her zero gravity quirk. She has a cheerful and confident personality, and she secretly has a crush on Deku. Her hero name is Uravity.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value: Shota Aizawa is class 1-A’s main teacher. His quirk is called “Erasure”, and it allows him to erase someone’s quirk temporarily as long as he doesn’t blink. This causes him to always be extremely tired. He has long black hair, tired eyes, white skin, and a black scarf that he uses as a weapon. He supervises most of class 1-A’s in school activities, and his hero name is Eraser Head.

cardPool.title: Class 1-A
cardPool.value: Class 1-A is the main first year hero course at UA. 1-A is taking the hero course, and their teacher is Mr. Aizawa. They all stay in Heights Alliance, and they have classes both in the classroom and out training.

cardPool.title: Tenya Iida
cardPool.value: Tenya Iida is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, residing in Heights Alliance, where he shares a dorm with his classmates, utilizing his powerful Quirk, Engine, which allows him to achieve high speeds, driven by his goal to become a great hero and live up to his family's expectations as a member of the prestigious Iida family. He has an uptight, strict, and controlling personality, aspiring for conduct and peace in the classroom. He has short dark blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build, and engines in his calves that allow him to achieve great speeds.  His hero name is Ingenium, and his hero suit is made of sleek white and blue armor.

cardPool.title: Tsuyu Asui
cardPool.value: Tsuyu Asui is a member of class 1-A, and her quirk is called frog, which allows her to do basically anything a frog can do. Her close friends call her Tsu, and she has long dark green hair in a bow-like style, large eyes, and a long frog-like tongue. Her hero suit is a green and black bodysuit with wearable goggles.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value: Eijiro Kirishima is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, known for having a hardening Quirk that allows him to transform his skin into a strong, rugged material that helps him excel in combat, and his goal is to become a hero who can protect others, driven by his desire to prove himself and make his friends proud. He has a loud and confident personality, and he is know for frequently using the word “manly”. His hero name is “Red Riot”, and he has tall and spiky red hair, white skin, a muscular build, and his hero suit has no shirt or sleeves, with circular accessories around his shoulders, baggy pants, and a belt with a large red letter R in the middle. When using his quirk at full power, he calls himself “Red Riot Unbreakable”, and it alters his physical appearance to be way more muscular for a short time.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value: Minoru Mineta is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, he possesses a quirk called Pop Off, which allows him to grow and explode grape-like clusters on his head, and he often uses this quirk for comedic effect and to distract enemies. He is known to be kind of a pervert, always eying down girls. He is very small, and he has purple hair that his clusters grow from, white skin, and his hero name is “Grape Juice”.

cardPool.title: Momo Yaoyorozu
cardPool.value: Momo Yaoyorozu is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, she possesses a quirk that allows her to create any object she can think of from her body. She has long black hair in a high ponytail, sharp dark eyes, white skin, and a tall build. She is known to be very rich, although she is very kind. Her hero outfit is a tight red leotard-like outfit that is open over the middle area of her breasts, which she normally uses to create things with her quirk. Her hero name is Creati.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value: Denki Kaminari is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, his Quirk, Electrification, allows him to generate and control electricity, although sometimes the electricity makes him temporarily stupid. He has spiky yellow hair with a black lightning bolt streak, white skin, and his hero suit is a black jacket with a white t shirt and a headset. His hero name is “Chargebolt”, and he has an outgoing personality.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value: Kyoka Jiro is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, she has a quirk gives her earphone jacks connected to her ears through skin like cords, which she can use to create sound waves and plug into things to listen for sounds. She is somewhat hesitant to talk about things she likes, but she is really into music, as she almost became a musician before deciding to become a hero. She has short, asymmetrical cut purple hair, sharp dark eyes, and she has a laid back personality. Her hero suit features a black leather jacket, a purple shirt, leggings with boots, red face paint under her eyes usually shaped like a tear drop, and taped hands. Her hero name is “Earphone Jack”.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero
cardPool.value: Hanta Sero is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, and his Quirk is called Tape, which allows him to produce strong tape from his elbows. He uses this Quirk for various purposes, including binding objects and people, and swinging from buildings. He has short black hair, a long face, a lean build, and he’s often smiling. His hero suit is black, white, and yellow with a helmet, and his hero name is Cellophane.

cardPool.title: Fumigake Tokoyami
cardPool.value: Fumigake Tokoyami is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, and his quirk is called Dark Shadow, which allows a bird like shadow being to be commanded by him, which is fueled by darkness. Tokoyami is a heteromorph, as his head is similar to that of a crow’s. His hero costume is just a dark cloak, giving him a mysterious shadow appearance. His hero name is Tsukuyomi.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value: Yuga Aoyama is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, known for his Navel Laser quirk, which allows him to shoot a powerful laser beam from his belly button. Yuga's actions are guided by his self-centered personality, and he is very fancy and elegant. His hero costume is similar to that of a knight’s armor, but with fancy red glasses. He has combed yellow hair, white skin, and sparkly eyes, and his hero name is “Can’t Stop Twinkling”.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value: Mashirao Ojiro is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, and he possesses a tail as a result of his quirk, which he uses for balance and combat. He has a confident personality, and he has short yellow hair, white skin, and his hero suit is a white robe. His hero name is “Tailman”.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value: Mina Ashido is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, and her Quirk allows her to produce and control acid. She has pink skin and pink fluffy hair, short yellow horns, and black eyes with yellow pupils. Her hero suit is a pink and blue camouflage body suit with a white fur collar, and she has an energetic and fun personality. Her hero name is “Pinky”.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value: Rikido Sato is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School. Rikido Sato possesses a Quirk called Sugar Rush that allows him to increase his physical abilities and strength by consuming sugar. He has large muscles and eats a lot, and he is very good at cooking. He has short brown hair, white skin, and large lips, and his hero suit is a yellow bodysuit. His hero name is “Sugarman”.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value: Mezo Shoji is a student in Class 1-A at UA High School, and he has a unique quirk that allows him to grow and manipulate multiple limbs from his body, which he uses for both combat and everyday activities. His quirk makes him a heteromorph, which makes his face longer. He has dark grey hair, and a tan-gray colored skin. His hero suit features a mask that covers the lower half of his face,  and a sleeveless dark grey top. His hero name is “Tentacole”.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value: Koji Koda is a student at UA High School whose quirk allows him to talk to animals. He is very quiet, and he is tall with gentle eyes. He is a heteromorph with a pointed head, and white skin. His hero suit is a red and orange jumpsuit, and a mask that amplifies his voice to animals. His hero name is “Anima”.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value: Toru Hagakure is a member of class 1-A with an invisibility quirk, which makes her completely invisible at all times. She has a cheerful and girly personality, and her hero outfit is just a pair of blue gloves. Her hero name is “Invisible Girl”.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value: All For One is a powerful villain who leads the League of Villains, his goal is to destroy the current hero society and create a new world order with him as the ruler, he possesses a quirk that allows him to steal and use other people's quirks, and his real name is unknown, but his motivations are driven by a desire for power and control. He has been alive for much longer than the average human, and his face is mostly deformed. He speaks profoundly and deeply, and he is a criminal mastermind.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value: Tomura Shigaraki is the leader of the League of Villains, a group that opposes the hero course at UA High School, and his goal is to destroy the current society and create a new one where villains are in power, driven by a strong desire for chaos and destruction, and he possesses a powerful quirk called Decay, which allows him to disintegrate anything he touches with his hands, and he is determined to use his abilities to achieve his objectives. He has pale skin, blue-gray shaggy hair, and red eyes, and his mentor is All For One. He often wears hands all over his body, which ease the constant itching he feels on his body.

cardPool.title: The League of Villians
cardPool.value: The League of Villians is a group formed by All for One and Tomura Shigaraki, with the goal of destroying the current hero society, and their members often train in secret locations like the abandoned factories on the outskirts of Musutafu, Japan, and they are motivated by a desire for power and control.

cardPool.title: Endeavor
cardPool.value: Endeavor is a pro hero who has been in the shadow of All Might for most of his pro hero career. He is the father of Todoroki, and he abused Todoroki as a child, and his mother. He has a fire quirk, that allows him to manipulate fire. He has brown hair, white skin, and a tall, muscular build, and he has a serious and mean demeanor compared to some other pro heroes. His real name is Enji Todoroki, and his hero suit is a dark fire resistant body suit.

cardPool.title: Hawks
cardPool.value: Hawks is a pro hero whose quirk allows him to have wings and manipulate feathers that come off his wings. He has a laid back personality, and he has messy blond hair, and golden brown eyes. His hero costume mainly features a tan jacket and visor-like goggles. His real name is Keigo Takami.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value: Himiko Toga is a member of the League of Villains, motivated by a desire to transform into anyone she likes by killing them and taking their blood. She has a powerful quirk called Transform, which allows her to take on the appearance and voice of anyone she has ingested a sample of their blood from, and she is driven by a goal to understand and replicate the feelings of others, often using her abilities to gather intelligence and manipulate those around her. She has a high pitched voice, blonde hair in two loose buns with loose strands, pale skin, and golden eyes with slit pupils. She often wears a cream colored cardigan, navy skirt, and a red scarf. She is mentally insane, and she has a crush on Izuku.

cardPool.title: Twice
cardPool.value: Jin Bubaigawara, also known as Twice, is a member of the League of Villains, and he has a Quirk that allows him to create perfect duplicates of anything or anyone, including himself. He has a split personality, one being his regular self and the other being a cockier version of himself that contradicts whatever he had just said. His hero suit is a black and white full body suit that also covers his whole head, and under the suit he has short blond hair and blue-gray eyes.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value: Kurogiri is a specialized nomu who serves All For One and Shigaraki in the league of villains. His actual name and appearance is unknown, as his quirk transforms him into a purple portal being who can make portals and transport things or people with them to anywhere. He is the right hand man to Shigaraki and All For One, and he doesn’t have any person opinions or a personality.

cardPool.title: UA Cafeteria
cardPool.value: The UA Cafeteria is a large open area where UA students occasionally eat lunch at. It has long tables, a food counter, and bright lighting and windows. The meals are all prepared by Lunch Rush.

cardPool.title: Lunch Rush
cardPool.value: Lunch Rush is a chef hero who makes the cafeteria food at UA. Often found in the cafeteria, Lunch Rush doesn’t speak much, and he wears a large robot like outfit with a chef’s hat. He has incredible cooking skills, particularly with Japanese food.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata
cardPool.value: Mirio Togata is a third year student at UA and a member of the “Big Three”. He had a cheerful and positive personality, and he had blonde hair and blue eyes. He has a muscular and strong build, and his quirk “Permeation” allows him to phase through solid matter, including the ground. His hero name is “Lemillion”, and his hero suit is a white body suit with red and blue armor accents and yellow boots and gloves.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value: Nejire Hado is a third year student at UA who is a member of the big three. Her quirk is called “Wave Motion” and allows her to create energy blasts from her body using her stamina, and her hero name is “Nejire Chan”. She has long wavy light blue hair, large, curious blue eyes, and a tall figure. She has a curious and energetic personality, and her hero costume is a futurist bodysuit in blue, white, and green that help project her energy blasts.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value: Tamaki Amajiki is a third year student at UA and a member of the big three. His quirk is called “Manifest” and allows him to temporarily take on the physical traits of anything he eats. He has purple hair that covers most of his face, and he is very introverted and shy. His hero costume is a cloak and mask giving him a mysterious appearance. His hero name is “Suneater”.

cardPool.title: The Big Three
cardPool.value: Togata, Hado, and Amajiki make up the “big three” at UA, which are three third year students who are exceptionally powerful and are the top three in their class. They sometimes mentor Class 1-A, and they seem to have bright futures as heroes.

cardPool.title: Spinner
cardPool.value: Spinner, real name Shuichi Iguchi, is a member of the League of Villians. His quirk is called Gecko, and it makes him a lizard-type heteromorph with a quirk lets him stick to walls. He has green, scaly skin and tall purple hair. He wears a bandana and sometimes goggles, and he carries tons of weapons on his back. He also idolizes Stain, and he mimics his own ideals and style.

cardPool.title: Stain
cardPool.value: Stain, real name Chizome Akaguro, is a vigilante turned villain who also calls himself the hero killer. His quirk, bloodcurdle, allows him to paralyze someone by licking their blood. He wears a red scarf, ragged clothes, and bandages, and he has spiky hair and uses a massive sword. He has an ideal that most heroes are fake and only want fame and money, and he made it his mission to kill them all. He says that All Might is the only true hero, and that he is the only hero worth of killing him.

cardPool.title: Heroes
cardPool.value: Heroes protect citizens and fight crime, using their quirks for justice. Each hero belongs to an agency that manages all of their hero work. As a UA student, you train in order to become a hero in the future, working for peace.

cardPool.title: Villians
cardPool.value: Villians are people who use their quirks for evil and commit crimes and chaos. They are almost always fighting heroes.

cardPool.title: Vigilantes
cardPool.value: Vigilantes are heroes who don’t belong to an agency yet still fight for justice, thus making them illegal and unofficial heroes. They share similar ideals to heroes, and they also fight villains.

cardPool.title: Shiketsu High School
cardPool.value: Shiketsu High School is the most prestigious school in Japan after UA. Located in the west, this school is a rival of UA’s, and their students wear uniforms with hats.

cardPool.title: Inasa Yoarashi
cardPool.value: Inasa Yoarashi is a student at Shiketsu High School. His quirk is called “gale force” and it allows him to create large gusts of wind. He has a black buzz cut, and he is tall and muscular. He is loud and super friendly, although he seems to have a grudge against Todoroki at UA.

cardPool.title: Camie Utsushimi
cardPool.value: Camie Utsushimi is a student at Shiketsu High, and her quirk is “glamour” which allows her to create realistic allusions. She has long brown hair, and she is tall with a flirty personality, and she often uses modern slang.

cardPool.title: Seiji Shishikura
cardPool.value: Seiji Shishikura is a student at Shiketsu High School, and his quirk is “meatball” which allows him to roll people’s flesh into meatballs, making them immobile while he uses his quirk. He has short purple hair, and he is stretch, arrogant, and he looks down on others, particularly those at UA.

cardPool.title: Mirko
cardPool.value: Mirko, whose real name is Rumi Usagiyama, is a pro hero with the quirk “rabbit” that allows her to have super strong kicks and insane agility like a rabbit. She has tan skin, long white hair, rabbit ears, a muscular build, and a white leotard-like hero costume. She has a fierce, confident, and sometimes cocky personality, and she is great at fighting.

cardPool.title: Midnight
cardPool.value: Midnight, whose real name is Nemuri Kayama, is a pro hero and teacher at UA. Her quirk, somnambulist, lets her release a purple gas that puts people to sleep, with it typically working better on men. She has long dark blue hair and a curvy build, and a tight bodysuit with a black eye mask as her hero suit. She has a serious yet slightly playful and flirty personality.

cardPool.title: Best Jeanist
cardPool.value: Best Jeanist, who’s real name is Tsunagu Hakumata, is a pro hero with the quirk fiber master, which allows him to control any fiber like clothes. He is tall and slim, and he has combed yellow hair. His hero suit is a full body suit made of denim, which also covers the bottom part of his face. He has a serious and disciplined personality, and he emphasizes proper etiquette and presentation.

cardPool.title: Mt. Lady
cardPool.value: Mt. Lady, who’s real name is Yu Takeyama, is a rookie pro hero whose quirk, gigantification, allows her grow extremely tall and large to heights of over 60 feet. She is tall and curvy, and she has long blonde hair. She has a tight white and purple bodysuit, along with a purple eye mask with horns. She is always chasing the spotlight, and she loves attention from the media.

cardPool.title: Hero Students
cardPool.value: Hero Students are heroes in training at UA High School, residing in Heights Alliance as members of Class 1-A. Hero students will often go out and do hero work similar to that of pro heroes.

cardPool.title: Lady Nagant
cardPool.value: Lady Nagant is a former pro hero who became a villain. Her real name is Kaina Tsutsumi, and her quirk, rifle, allows her arms into a sniper rifle and use her hair as bullets. She is tall with pale skin, purple hair, and an intimidating look with a calm and cold personality. Her motivation is to prove the corruption in hero society, hence the reason she became a villain.

cardPool.title: Ryukyu
cardPool.value: Ryukyu is a pro hero whose quirk, dragon, allows her to turn into a dragon. Her real name is Ryuko Tatsuma, and in her human form she has white skin and yellow hair. She has a calm, professional personality.

cardPool.title: Fat Gum
cardPool.value: Fat Gum, whose real name is Taishiro Toyomitsu, is a pro hero with the quirk Fat Absorption, which makes his body huge and round, fueled by food consumption. He has a bright yellow body suit with a small black eye mask, and he has white skin and yellow hair that is rarely seen, and a huge smile at almost all times. He is kind, upbeat, and supportive, and he is very strong and protective in combat.

cardPool.title: Sir Nighteye
cardPool.value: Sir Nighteye, whose real name is Mirai Sasaki, is a pro hero who was formerly All Might’s sidekick. His quirk is called foresight, and it allows him to see one hour into someone else’s future. He is tall and neat with slicked back hair and white skin, and he usually dresses in a suit and tie. He is strict and logical, and very efficient.
